sections.markdown:
## C — Collision response, reporting and liability insurance

FACT_ID: sec15-F01 | anchor: A01
The handbook says not to stop at a crash unless involved or emergency help has not arrived. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F02 | anchor: A01
While passing a crash, concentrate on driving and watch for people beside or within the road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F03 | anchor: A01
Do not travel to a crash, fire or disaster merely to watch, because you may obstruct responders and recovery vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec15-F04 | anchor: A02
A driver involved in a crash must stop. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F05 | anchor: A02
When a crash involves a parked vehicle, try to locate its owner. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F06 | anchor: A02
The manual suggests carrying a basic emergency kit with flares, first-aid materials and simple tools. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F07 | anchor: A02
Stop at or near the crash site; if the vehicle can move, move it off the roadway to prevent obstruction or another crash. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F08 | anchor: A02
Keep out of traffic lanes rather than standing or walking in them. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F09 | anchor: A02
At the scene, the handbook instructs turning off wrecked vehicles’ ignitions and avoiding smoking because spilled fuel can ignite. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F10 | anchor: A02
Stay away from fallen power lines and wires lying on the road. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F11 | anchor: A02
The manual calls for flares or other warning devices to alert approaching traffic and prevent another vehicle joining the crash. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F12 | anchor: A02
If anyone is injured, ensure police and emergency medical or rescue help have been called; report any fire when calling police. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F13 | anchor: A02
The source says not to move injured people unless their vehicle is burning or another vehicle presents an immediate impact threat. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F14 | anchor: A02
Moving an injured person can worsen the injuries. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F15 | anchor: A02
The manual’s first-aid sequence prioritizes anyone not already walking and talking, then checks breathing before bleeding. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F16 | anchor: A02
For bleeding, the source directs pressure straight onto the wound with a hand or cloth. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F17 | anchor: A02
The source directs giving an injured person no drink, including water. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec15-F18 | anchor: A02
The handbook advises keeping an injured person warm with a coat or blanket to help prevent shock. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0037]

Misconceptions: insurance penalties described here concern vehicle registration and plates; do not silently substitute driver-license suspension.
Mnemonics: stop, protect the scene, summon help, exchange and record.
Glossary: liability coverage pays for covered injury or damage to others; a witness may supply crash information; a warning device alerts approaching traffic.
Dynamic facts: present emergency instructions, official reporting duties and current insurance law require verification.

verification_debt.claim_text: Page37 injured-person movement exceptions, breathing/bleeding sequence, direct pressure, nothing to drink and keeping warm are snapshot source descriptions requiring current emergency-care/clinical review before teaching. No CPR protocol, infection-control exemption, diagnosis or individual medical treatment is inferred.

Pages36–37 stopping/moving a crash vehicle, ignition and flare guidance require current official responder and site-safety review. Do not infer a duty for every uninvolved passerby to stop, or permission to approach fire, power lines or traffic lanes.
